stories.name_fr: Croissance annuelle du chiffre d’affaires visée à 2030
stories.explanation: Croissance annuelle moyenne des ventes nettes, base 2025.
stories.story_fr: Deere vise une croissance annuelle moyenne de 10 % de ses ventes nettes de 2025 à 2030.
stories.story_en: Deere targets a 10% net sales CAGR from 2025 to 2030.
stories.citation: an applied 10% net sales CAGR would results in around $63 billion by 2030

stories.name_fr: Marge opérationnelle à travers le cycle visée à 2030
stories.name_en: Through-cycle operating return on sales target by 2030
stories.explanation: Operating return on sales à travers le cycle.
stories.story_fr: Deere vise un retour opérationnel sur ventes de 20 % à travers le cycle d’ici 2030.
stories.story_en: Deere targets 20% through-cycle operating return on sales by 2030.
stories.citation: committed to our goal of delivering 20% through cycle OROS, by 2030

stories.story_fr: Deere vise un retour opérationnel sur actifs de 45 %.
stories.story_en: Deere aims for a 45% operating return on assets.
stories.citation: we additionally aim for 45% Operating Return on Assets

stories.explanation: Acres engagés sur la plateforme Operations Center.
stories.story_fr: Deere vise 600 millions d’acres engagés d’ici 2030, avec plus de 500 millions aujourd’hui.
stories.story_en: Deere aims for 600 million engaged acres by 2030, with over 500 million today.
stories.citation: Our goal is to continue expanding engaged acres to 600 million by 2030

stories.name_fr: Utilisateurs numériques actifs mensuels uniques visés à 2030
stories.name_en: Unique active monthly digital users target by 2030
stories.explanation: Nouvelle mesure d’engagement de l’Operations Center.
stories.story_fr: Deere vise 1 million d’utilisateurs numériques actifs mensuels uniques d’ici 2030, contre environ 400 000 aujourd’hui.
stories.story_en: Deere aims to reach 1 million unique active monthly digital users by 2030, from about 400,000 today.
stories.citation: We have about 400,000 Unique Active Monthly Digital Users today, and our goal is to reach 1 million by 2030.

stories.story_fr: Deere prévoit plus de 9 milliards de dollars de valeur actionnariale ajoutée à mi-cycle sur une seule année.
stories.story_en: Deere expects more than $9 billion of shareholder value add at mid-cycle in a single year.
stories.citation: That would equate to more than $9 billion in Shareholder Value Add at mid-cycle in a single year

stories.name_fr: Flux de trésorerie libre restitué sur 25 ans
stories.name_en: Free cash flow returned over 25 years
stories.story_fr: Deere a restitué plus de 80 % de son flux de trésorerie libre restant aux actionnaires en 25 ans.
stories.story_en: Deere returned more than 80% of its remaining free cash flow to shareholders over 25 years.
stories.citation: Over the past 25 years, we've returned more than 80% of our remaining free cash flow from the equipment operations to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases.
